messages:
maya: quick ping — PR #8346 landed a small change to allocator scheduling. CI canary bench shows p95 +4% on 4kseq and avg RSS +60MB. attaching artifacts: https://ci.redwood/bench/1749812345 :eyes:
kevin: saw it, thanks for the heads up. is that canary-only or full-traffic? can you paste the bench summary?
maya: canary only (us-west rtx-a). summary: p50 ~= baseline, p95 +4.1%, p99.9 shows intermittent spikes. mem RSS +60MB average (no OOM). full artifact: https://ci.redwood/bench/1749812345/report.html
olga: do we have flamegraphs / hotspot diffs? any stack that grew significantly?
maya: attaching flame + heatmap: https://ci.redwood/bench/1749812345/flame.svg and https://ci.redwood/bench/1749812345/heatmap.png. quick grep from perf shows increased time in `kv_shard_lock` path: ```text
kv_shard_lock wait 23% -> 31%
```
tim: hmm that lock increase could line up with the prefetch/tiling tweak in the PR. which commit changed it?
maya: commit a3f4d2b — altered prefetch window sizing to prefer earlier allocation on shard fill. suspect shift in contention pattern.
kevin: can we reproduce with microbench? maya, please add microbench config or I'll run `bench micro --shard 16 --seq 4096`. if reproducible, hold merge.
maya: starting microbench now, will paste results. also pinging @olga for a quick code skim — change is in allocator.cc around lines 210-260.
olga: will take a look today. if microbench matches, i think we should block merge or add a guard.
bench-bot: microbench finished. artifacts: https://ci.redwood/bench/1749812345/micro.json. result summary: p95 +6%, avg RSS +72MB. full logs at https://ci.redwood/bench/1749812345/micro.log
maya: thanks. minimal repro command for folks: ```bash
./run_micro_bench --shards=16 --seq=4096 --iters=200 --profile=flame
```
kevin: ok i'm blocking merge for now. request: add a runtime config flag (old_prefetch=true/false) so we can merge with old behavior default and flip in canary, plus a follow-up perf run. also need 2nd approval from @olga before unblocking.
tim: alternative is revert the commit for now, but guard/flag seems lower friction.
maya: i'll open a quick follow-up PR with the feature flag and perf toggles, should be ~30m. will tag bench artifacts and micro runs.
olga: ack, will review the follow-up PR. @maya please include perf numbers with flag on vs off so we can baseline.
kevin: also add a perf-harness assertion: `assert(kv_shard_lock_pct < 25)` for 4kseq in the nightly perf job, so we catch regressions earlier.
maya: will add the assertion and the flag, and post back here once PR is up. thx :thumbsup:
maya: (follow-up) PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/8361 — includes flag and bench attachments. marking merge held until 2nd approval and perf sign-off.
